relationship\nfrom database import Base\n\nclass User(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"users\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    username = Column(String, unique=True, nullable=False)\n    full_name = Column(String)\n    email = Column(String, unique=True)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\n\nclass Program(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"programs\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    name = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    degree_type = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\n\nclass Term(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"terms\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    name = Column(String, unique=True, nullable=False)\n    start_date = Column(Date)\n    end_date = Column(Date)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\n\nclass ProgramTerm(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"program_terms\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    program_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"programs.id\"), nullable=False)\n    term_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"terms.id\"), nullable=False)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\n    __table_args__ = (\n        UniqueConstraint(\"program_id\", \"term_id\"),\n    )\n\n\nclass ReviewCommittee(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"review_committees\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    name = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\n\nclass ReviewStage(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"review_stages\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    committee_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"review_committees.id\"), nullable=False)\n    name = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    stage_order = Column(Integer, nullable=False)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\n    __table_args__ = (\n        UniqueConstraint(\"committee_id\", \"name\"),\n    )\n\n\nclass Applicant(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"applicants\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    first_name = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    last_name = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    email = Column(String, unique=True)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\n\nclass Application(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"applications\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    applicant_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"applicants.id\"), nullable=False)\n    program_term_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"program_terms.id\"), nullable=False)\n    submitted_at = Column(DateTime)\n    final_decision = Column(String, CheckConstraint(\"final_decision IN ('admit', 'waitlist', 'deny')\"))\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\n\nclass ReviewAssignment(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"review_assignments\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    application_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"applications.id\"), nullable=False)\n    reviewer_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"users.id\"), nullable=False)\n    stage_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"review_stages.id\"), nullable=False)\n    assigned_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime,       "path": "schemas.py",
      "content": "from pydantic import BaseModel\nfrom typing import List, Optional\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\n\nclass ReviewWorkloadOut(BaseModel):\n    reviewer_id: Optional[int] = None\n    reviewer_name: Optional[str] = None\n    stage_id: Optional[int] = None\n    stage_name: Optional[str] = None\n    total_assigned: int\n    decided_count: int\n    decision_percentage: Optional[float] = None\n\n    model_config = {\n        \"from_attributes\": True\n    }\n\n\nclass ReviewWorkloadResponse(BaseModel):\n    workload_data: List[ReviewWorkloadOut]\n\n    model_config = {\n        \"from_attributes\": True\n    }"
    },
    {
      "path": "routers/group_001.py",
      "content": "from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException\nfrom sqlalchemy.orm import Session\nfrom sqlalchemy import func, case, and_\nfrom database import get_db\nfrom models import ReviewAssignment, Application, User, ReviewStage, ReviewCommittee, ProgramTerm\nfrom schemas import ReviewWorkloadResponse\n\nrouter = APIRouter(tags=[\"ReviewWorkload\"])\n\n\n@router.get(\n    \"/api/review-workload/{program_term_id}\",\n    operation_id=\"get_review_workload\",\n    response_model=ReviewWorkloadResponse\n)\nasync def get_review_workload(program_term_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):\n    # Subquery to count all assigned applications per reviewer and stage\n    assigned_subq = (\n        db.query(\n            ReviewAssignment.reviewer_id,\n            ReviewAssignment.stage_id,\n            func.count(ReviewAssignment.application_id).label(\"total_assigned\")\n        )\n        .join(Application, ReviewAssignment.application_id == Application.id)\n        .filter(Application.program_term_id == program_term_id)\n        .group_by(ReviewAssignment.reviewer_id, ReviewAssignment.stage_id)\n        .subquery()\n    )\n\n    # Subquery to count decided applications (with final_decision)\n    decided_subq = (\n        db.query(\n            ReviewAssignment.reviewer_id,\n            ReviewAssignment.stage_id,\n            func.count(Application.id).label(\"decided_count\")\n        )\n        .join(Application, ReviewAssignment.application_id == Application.id)\n        .filter(\n            and_(\n                Application.program_term_id == program_term_id,\n                Application.final_decision.isnot(None)\n            )\n        )\n        .group_by(ReviewAssignment.reviewer_id, ReviewAssignment.stage_id)\n        .subquery()\n    )\n\n    # Main query joining subqueries with user and stage info\n    query = (\n        db.query(\n            User.id.label(\"reviewer_id\"),\n            User.full_name.label(\"reviewer_name\"),\n            ReviewStage.id.label(\"stage_id\"),\n            ReviewStage.name.label(\"stage_name\"),\n            assigned_subq.c.total_assigned,\n            decided_subq.c.decided_count,\n            case(\n                (\n                    assigned_subq.c.total_assigned > 0,\n                    func.cast(decided_subq.c.decided_count, func.float()) / func.cast(assigned_subq.c.total_assigned, func.float()) * 100\n                ),\n                else_=None\n            ).label(\"decision_percentage\")\n        )\n        .select_from(assigned_subq)\n        .outerjoin(decided_subq, and_(\n            assigned_subq.c.reviewer_id == decided_subq.c.reviewer_id,\n            assigned_subq.c.stage_id == decided_subq.c.stage_id\n        ))\n        .outerjoin(User, assigned_subq.c.reviewer_id == User.id)\n        .outerjoin(ReviewStage, assigned_subq.c.stage_id == ReviewStage.id)\n        .order_by(User.full_name, ReviewStage.stage_order)\n    )\n\n    results = query.all()\n\n    return ReviewWorkloadResponse(workload_data=results)"
    }
  ]
